status.description: LGTM if notes is empty; ACTION_REQUIRED if notes has at least one violation.

notes.description: One entry per rule violation. Empty when status is LGTM.

file.description: Path (relative to repo root) of the file containing the violation. If the finding spans multiple files, use the single most representative file here and mention the others in text.

text.description: At most 2 sentences (about 50 words): where the violation is, and why that code violates the rule. A final verdict only: no reasoning, reconsidering, or hedging. If unsure it is a violation, omit the note instead.
